description: Historical single-process Meep timing on the old unmatched smoke scaffold. These measurements do not establish antenna S11 accuracy or a cost-to-accuracy comparison.

provenance.host: AWS m6i.4xlarge (16 vCPU Intel Ice Lake, 61 GB RAM), Ubuntu 22.04
provenance.problem: Historical unmatched smoke scaffold: flat FR-4 slab, infinite flat PEC ground, rectangular PEC patch proxy, point-Ez readout; see meep_runtime_bench.py.
provenance.note: per-step timing = steady-state seconds/timestep over 61 timesteps after warmup; single-tenant (no co-tenant contention).

scaling_law.s_per_step_vs_R: power-law fit exponent ~2.92 (memory-bandwidth-bound, near-cubic in R); s_per_step ~= 0.00418 * R^2.92 s
scaling_law.dt_vs_R: dt ~ 1/R (measured: 0.125 -> 0.0417 across R=4..12), the CFL/Courant condition

measured_anchor.note: Earlier single-tenant R=8 forward-to-decay observation on the same box.
measured_anchor.wallclock_min: >=12 (did NOT reach field decay within a 15-min window)
measured_anchor.implication: one forward solve at R=8 is >=12 min and unconverged; one adjoint gradient ~2x.

projection.disclaimer: Projections extrapolate the measured power laws; clearly NOT measured. Conservative (lower-bound) absolute times use the R=8 >=421-step anchor.
projection.full_band_optimization_hours_at_R8: WITHDRAWN: multiplying by frequency count ignores Meep broadband/adjoint reuse; no optimized broadband workflow was timed.
projection.full_band_optimization_hours_at_R12: WITHDRAWN: extrapolated from the unsupported R8 workflow estimate.
projection.cells_at_curve_faithful_resolution: WITHDRAWN: R=250 is not an established accuracy requirement. The corrected illustrative cell count is 2.52e12.
projection.R250_note: Illustrative resolution only. The old arbitrary 1 micron conformal-equivalence target is withdrawn; no required EM accuracy is assigned to R=250.
projection.R250_ram_note: About 5,700 times the R=14 cell-count/RAM wall under cubic storage scaling; this is extrapolation, not measured memory.

geode_comparison.method: unstructured tetrahedral Nedelec H(curl) FEM shape adjoint, single reused factorization
geode_comparison.result: full 73-DOF freeform curved-conformal band match to worst-of-band -12.06 dB
geode_comparison.cost: Historical six-step run; timing boundaries and geometric accuracy were not matched to Meep.
geode_comparison.status: Historical result on a different discretization/model; not matched-model or same-host cost-to-accuracy evidence.

conclusion: The measured historical runtime grows with resolution. A matched-geometry S11 convergence study (#1088), not a perimeter plateau or arbitrary geometric threshold, is required to compare solver cost at equal accuracy.
